image_description: A long, symmetrical interior corridor of a prison or institutional building. The hallway features high ceilings with exposed concrete beams and hanging light fixtures. The walls are two-toned, with white upper sections and green lower wainscoting. Sunlight streams in from the left through barred windows, casting distinct rectangular shadows on the floor. At the far end of the corridor, a heavy barred gate or window is visible, reinforcing the secure nature of the facility.
